title: ALIVE: The Final Evolution
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An alien entity called Akuro, made of immortal souls that long to die, reaches Earth and enters human bodies, triggering a worldwide wave of suicides. Teens who resist its pull gain superpowers; Taisuke Kanou sets out to rescue his friend Megumi after his friend Hirose turns his new power to kidnapping her. With fellow survivors Yuta and Nami, Taisuke fights Hirose and others until Akuro's pieces leave their hosts and the world returns to peace.
life_message: Choosing to live, and protecting the people you love, is worth fighting for even when despair is everywhere.

folkways.japan: Akuro's consciousness is named Mitama, a Japanese term for spirit, reflecting Shinto-tinged ideas of souls that need settling.
